description: This file defines an interface for the ssp_messagebus component, including function prototypes for message bus engagement, initialization, finalization, resource cleanup, and a wait condition function. It primarily serves as a contract for implementing message bus interactions in the XxxxSsp project.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the message bus interface, performing cleanup of resources.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus connection or configuration.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus based on priority and user data.

methods.name: waitConditionReady
methods.description: Blocks until the specified wait condition related to message bus readiness is satisfied.
